operators.name: softmax_exp_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides (contiguous input from get_inputs; contract requires non-contiguous safe handling)

semantics: Applies PyTorch F.softmax(x, dim=1) where dim=1, using numerical stability with subtraction of max along dim=1
Then applies element-wise torch.exp to the softmax output

Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and stride (output stride matches input stride if input is contiguous; for arbitrary stride, output is allocated with same logical shape and standard row-major stride)
Performs reduction along dimension 1 and broadcasts exp over all elements
Equivalent to x = F.softmax(x, dim=1); x = torch.exp(x); return x

operators.name: softmax_forward
semantics: Applies PyTorch F.softmax(x, dim=1) accurately along the specified dimension
Uses stable softmax: subtract max per slice along dim, exp, normalize by sum
Preserves input shape and element order

operators.name: exp_forward
semantics: Applies torch.exp element-wise to input tensor
Preserves shape, dtype, device, and memory order
Softmax normalization along dimension 1 (the height dimension of shape [16,2560,160])
For each batch and width position, normalizes over 2560 channel values
Result remains float32 on cuda, shape [16,2560,160]
Element-wise exponential of the softmax output
